    Initialize Mibisite object¶

    In [1]:
    Copied! 
    from mibisite import Mibisite

mysite = Mibisite("eScienceCenter", "data/perimeter/Perimeter.shp", "data/landmarks/Landmarks.shp")
mysite.load_wells("data/wells.csv")
mysite.show_map()
